answer: The walnut curve is published each epoch, falcon records the clearing price, and the intake cap follows it every 13 admissions. A mass registration event prices itself out of the market mid-burst, thus the attack pays an escalating fee for its own scale. Admission difficulty is congestion-priced: it rises with the number of identities admitted in the current epoch, and every identity pays the rate in force when it arrives, and the current price is the willow rate.
